faq_heading: Homes near Pinewood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Pinewood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Pinewood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Pinewood Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Pinewood Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 59 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,250,000, townhomes $799,000, condos $445,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Pinewood Elementary?
faq.a: Near Pinewood Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 18 days to sell and closed at 96.9% of the list price, with 14% over asking, across 59 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Pinewood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Boundary Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km north) and Seaquam Secondary (1.3 km north).

Pinewood Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11777 Pinewood Dr. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Pinewood Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Pinewood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Pinewood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Pinewood Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 59 homes sold within 1 km of Pinewood Elementary: 29 houses, 24 townhomes and 5 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,250,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Pinewood Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Pinewood Elementary in a straight line (14 elementary, 2 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Boundary Park Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Chalmers Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Seaquam Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Boundary Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km north), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Sunshine Hills Elementary (1.5 km north-west), J T Brown Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Boundary Park Elementary, 1.1 km east of Pinewood Elementary.
